Lashkar Commander Claims Indian Agents Killed Over 30 Operatives in Pakistan

Rizwan Hanif, a Lashkar-e-Taiba commander, has claimed in a video that Indian agents killed over 30 of their operatives in Pakistan and Pakistan-occupied Jammu and Kashmir since 2020. Hanif alleged these killings were acts of religious persecution. This is reportedly the first time a Lashkar-e-Taiba terrorist has publicly admitted to such killings. The coverage does not include any denial or statement from India.
